app.name: NINJA SAMURAI WORKOUT: GHOST
title.lead: Stand your phone upright so it sees your whole body, then cut down yokai with real swings. One falls, the next appears. Finish bosses with a final blow and hold your zanshin.
title.formnote: You have not registered any forms yet, so swings are judged against standard values. Register your own ideal swings under Register forms for steadier judging.
mode.adv.desc: Yokai keep coming. Every kill drops gear and sword parts, with a boss every fifth. It lasts until your HP runs out or you rest.
menu.forms.desc: Record your ideal swing for all 9 forms
setup.weapons.label: Register up to 2 weapons (what you actually hold)
setup.weapons.note: Heavier weapons hit harder per swing and give a longer COMBO window. A short blade makes you a shinobi; anything else, a samurai.
setup.diff.label: Judging level (your training rank)
setup.diff.note: Higher levels multiply damage and EXP. At every level, swings are compared with the speed, direction, reach, wobble and slow-down of your registered forms.
setup.height.note: Used to turn the camera's 3D estimate into real speed (m/s).
setup.atk.note: If you fail to dodge, you lose HP. At 0 HP the fight counts as a rest and that yokai scores 0.
setup.safety: Never use a real blade. Swing a bokuto, an iaito, a broom or a towel. Keep more than arm-plus-weapon length clear in every direction, away from people, furniture and lights.
diff.0.name: NYUMON
diff.0.desc: Counts a swing even if it is a little slow or shaky
diff.1.name: SHODAN
diff.1.desc: Ignores hand waving and the sword coming back
diff.2.name: SANDAN
diff.2.desc: Needs the direction and speed of the form
diff.3.name: SHIHAN
diff.3.desc: Allows almost no wobble or slow-down
diff.4.name: SHIN'IKI
diff.4.desc: Only a flawless, god-like swing counts
type.shinmen.hint: From straight above to straight down
type.kiriage.hint: From straight below to straight up
type.kesa.hint: From upper right to lower left
type.gyakukesa.hint: From upper left to lower right
type.kesaage.hint: From lower left to upper right
type.gyakukesaage.hint: From lower right to upper left
forms.lead: Swing your ideal cut three times for each form to register it. From then on, swings are judged against it for speed, direction, reach, wobble and slow-down. Unregistered forms use standard values. Left and right are as you see yourself in the mirrored camera image.
forms.saved: Registered · {peak} m/s ({kg} kg) · reach {amp} m · wobble {wob}
gear.total.label: Total from gear and shikigami
gear.bushiOnly: Gear, sword traits, shikigami, skills and levels only work in the BUSHI division. In the SAMURAI division you fight on bare skill.
gear.wrongKind: {kind} parts cannot be equipped with your current weapon
gear.empty: No gear yet. Slay yokai to find some.

sword.sword_01_doujigiri.name: DOJIGIRI YASUTSUNA
sword.sword_01_doujigiri.lore: The tachi with which Minamoto no Yorimitsu is said to have struck off the head of Shuten-doji, lord of the oni of Mount Oe. Counted among the Five Swords Under Heaven.
sword.sword_01_doujigiri.flavor: Speak an oni's name, and the blade rings in its scabbard.
sword.sword_02_higekiri.name: HIGEKIRI
sword.sword_02_higekiri.lore: A treasured sword of the Minamoto, named because a test cut sliced through a prisoner's very beard. Some say it is the blade Watanabe no Tsuna used to cut off an oni's arm at Ichijo Modori Bridge.
sword.sword_02_higekiri.flavor: The blade that took an oni's arm does not miss twice.
sword.sword_02_higekiri.set4: After three S ranks in a row, your next cut is a sure critical
sword.sword_03_kumokiri.name: KUMOKIRI
sword.sword_03_kumokiri.lore: Called Hizamaru after a test cut went through to the knees, it was renamed Kumokiri when the ailing Minamoto no Yorimitsu cut down the Tsuchigumo with it. The pair of Higekiri.
sword.sword_03_kumokiri.flavor: Cut the presence before the thread is spun.
sword.sword_03_kumokiri.set4: Enemy attack warnings come 0.3 seconds earlier
sword.sword_04_shishiou.name: SHISHIO
sword.sword_04_shishiou.lore: The tachi the emperor is said to have granted Minamoto no Yorimasa for shooting down the Nue that haunted the palace.
sword.sword_04_shishiou.flavor: Whatever hides deepest in the thunderclouds flinches the most.
sword.sword_05_kogitsunemaru.name: KOGITSUNEMARU
sword.sword_05_kogitsunemaru.lore: A tachi forged by Sanjo Munechika, the Noh play Kokaji tells, with a fox, the messenger of Inari, striking the hammer beside him.
sword.sword_05_kogitsunemaru.flavor: A blade struck by a fox never overlooks a fox.
sword.sword_05_kogitsunemaru.set4: Damage +40% against fox yokai; golden yokai appear 30% more often
sword.sword_06_sohaya.name: SOHAYA
sword.sword_06_sohaya.lore: Said to be the sword of Sakanoue no Tamuramaro, who in legend defeated the demon god Otakemaru.
sword.sword_06_sohaya.flavor: Even an oni that brings the storm falls before it can speak its name.
sword.sword_07_onimaru.name: ONIMARU KUNITSUNA
sword.sword_07_onimaru.lore: A small oni haunted Hojo Tokiyori's dreams night after night, until the tachi leaning by his bed fell by itself and cut it down. One of the Five Swords Under Heaven.
sword.sword_07_onimaru.flavor: Even in dreams, the blade moves first.
sword.sword_07_onimaru.set4: Damage +50% for the first 10 seconds of a fight
sword.sword_07_onimaru.source: Defeat an oni taisho while climbing
sword.sword_08_mikazuki.name: MIKAZUKI MUNECHIKA
sword.sword_08_mikazuki.lore: A tachi whose temper line shows crescent-moon shapes. Called the most beautiful of the Five Swords Under Heaven.
sword.sword_08_mikazuki.flavor: A beautiful cut needs no excuse.
sword.sword_09_odenta.name: ODENTA MITSUYO
sword.sword_09_odenta.lore: Handed down in the Maeda house of Kaga; laid by the pillow of a sick princess, it is said to have cured her. One of the Five Swords Under Heaven.
sword.sword_09_odenta.flavor: A blade also guards the life of the one who wields it.
sword.sword_09_odenta.set4: Max HP +30%; recover 5% HP every 30 seconds
sword.sword_10_amenohabakiri.name: AME NO HABAKIRI
sword.sword_10_amenohabakiri.lore: One name of the ten-span sword with which Susanoo slew Yamata no Orochi. When it cut the serpent's tail its edge chipped, and from the tail a sword appeared.
sword.sword_11_amenoohabari.name: AME NO OHABARI
sword.sword_11_amenoohabari.lore: The ten-span sword with which Izanagi cut down Kagutsuchi, god of fire, as the Kojiki records.
sword.sword_11_amenoohabari.flavor: The blade that cut a god now hangs at your hip.
sword.sword_12_shionari.name: SHIONARI
sword.sword_12_shionari.lore: On a stormy night a samurai of a fishing village cut the shadow of Umibozu and pulled this tachi from the waves. Hold the blade to your ear and you hear the surf.
sword.sword_12_shionari.flavor: Cut in the instant the wave draws back.
sword.sword_13_isokiri.name: ISOKIRI
sword.sword_13_isokiri.lore: To drive off the Ushi-oni of the rocky shore, a beach smith forged this tachi with powdered shell in the steel. Salt spray never rusts it.
sword.sword_13_isokiri.flavor: As hard as the rocks of a wild shore.
sword.sword_14_mukurodachi.name: MUKURODACHI
sword.sword_14_mukurodachi.lore: A nameless smith spent his whole life forging this tachi to cut down the giant skeleton born from the bones piled on battlefields.
sword.sword_14_mukurodachi.flavor: The greater the thing, the cleaner it falls to one cut.
sword.sword_15_karahashi.name: KARAHASHI
sword.sword_15_karahashi.lore: Named after the legend of the giant centipede slain at the Seta Karahashi bridge. Like counting a hundred legs, this blade never rests.
sword.sword_15_karahashi.flavor: One unbroken chain beats a hundred legs.
sword.sword_16_kageuchi.name: KAGEUCHI
sword.sword_16_kageuchi.lore: When a master forges a great sword, the spare forged beside the chosen one is called the kageuchi. This dojo's kageuchi goes only to those who cut the master's shadow.
sword.sword_16_kageuchi.flavor: Whoever cuts the shadow forges the shadow.
sword.sword_16_kageuchi.set4: Damage +20%, damage taken -10%. Your shadow-cut turns gold
sword.sword_16_kageuchi.source: Cut the master's shadow for the first time (samurai)
sword.sword_17_imanotsurugi.name: IMA NO TSURUGI
sword.sword_17_imanotsurugi.lore: Said to be the guardian dagger of Minamoto no Yoshitsune, who as a boy learned the arts of war from tengu on Mount Kurama.
sword.sword_17_imanotsurugi.flavor: Feet taught by tengu leap without touching the ground.
sword.sword_17_imanotsurugi.set4: After a dodge, your next 3 chained hits deal +30%
sword.sword_18_yagentoushirou.name: YAGEN TOSHIRO
sword.sword_18_yagentoushirou.lore: A dagger that pierced even an iron mortar, yet the story goes it would never wound its own master.
sword.sword_18_yagentoushirou.flavor: It pierces iron. It guards its master.
sword.sword_18_yagentoushirou.set4: Once per fight, survive a fatal hit with 1 HP
sword.sword_19_nikkari.name: NIKKARI AOE
sword.sword_19_nikkari.lore: A woman's ghost grinned at a man on a night road and he cut her down; in the morning only a stone lantern lay there, split in two.
sword.sword_19_nikkari.flavor: Whoever laughs in the dark may not be human.
sword.sword_20_honebami.name: HONEBAMI TOSHIRO
sword.sword_20_honebami.lore: It was said that merely pretending to cut with it shattered a foe's bones. Legend says it was once a naginata.
sword.sword_20_honebami.flavor: The fight begins before the swing.
sword.sword_20_honebami.set4: Staggers need one fewer chained hit
sword.sword_21_kamaitachi.name: KAMAITACHI
sword.sword_21_kamaitachi.lore: A dagger said to hide the claw of the whirlwind weasel in its hilt. Swing it, and the wind follows a beat behind.
sword.sword_21_kamaitachi.flavor: Cut before the wind, and leave before the wind.
sword.sword_22_kirigakure.name: KIRIGAKURE
sword.sword_22_kirigakure.lore: A dagger handed down by the shinobi of a misty mountain village. Draw it, and a thin mist rises round the blade.
sword.sword_22_kirigakure.flavor: What cannot be seen cannot be cut.
sword.sword_22_kirigakure.set4: For 2 seconds after a hit, you take no damage
sword.sword_23_kagenui.name: KAGENUI
sword.sword_23_kagenui.lore: Given only to the shinobi who cuts the master's shadow. It pins a shadow to the ground and slows its owner, just a little.
sword.sword_23_kagenui.flavor: Stitch the shadow, and the body lags behind.
sword.sword_23_kagenui.set4: Enemy attack warnings last 0.5 seconds longer
sword.sword_23_kagenui.source: Cut the master's shadow for the first time (shinobi)
sword.sword_24_yonaki.name: YONAKI
sword.sword_24_yonaki.lore: A dagger said to cry faintly in its scabbard only on nights when the night sparrow sings.
sword.sword_24_yonaki.flavor: Train at night, and the blade wakes too.
book.note: Slain yokai sometimes become your shikigami. Golden yokai are rare, with more HP and EXP, and become shikigami more easily. Taming the same yokai again deepens your bond (★). The blessing of the one shikigami you bring along works in BUSHI fights.

map.title: YOKAI TAIJI
map.note: Points from defeated yokai add up. Resting mid-fight (retreating, not swinging for a minute, or dropping to 0 HP) scores 0 for the yokai you were fighting and ends the run.
map.locked: Appears after you slay the previous yokai
battle.place1:
Stand your phone upright, step back 2–3 m
and make sure you are visible from head to feet.
battle.place2: Facing the camera gives the steadiest tracking.
battle.demo.tip: Try it without a camera (Space also works)
battle.gestureHelp: Hands-free: cross your forearms in front of your chest for 2 seconds to retreat. On the result screen, raise both hands above your head for 1 second for the next yokai (it also moves on by itself after 15 seconds), or cross your forearms to stop.

run.end.ko: Your HP reached 0, so this counts as a rest. The yokai you were fighting scores 0.

mode.climb.desc: From Lv 1 every day: how high can you get up the same mountain? Pick up where you left off as often as you like. A new mountain at 22:00 JST.
climb.day: Next mountain in {h}h {m}m (switches at {time} your time)
climb.div.bushi: Only today's gear. Zashiki-warashi may appear
climb.div.samurai: No gear. Everyone meets the same yokai
climb.start.desc: A boss every 5 floors. Best to rest right after a kill
climb.note: The climb starts at Lv 1 every day. Nothing is carried in: in the Bushi division you use only gear found that day, and better pieces go on automatically. Resting mid-fight (retreating, not swinging for a minute, or dropping to 0 HP) scores 0 for that yokai, and next time you face it again at full HP. Gear and LV from the climb vanish at the 22:00 JST switch.
climb.drops: Today's gear (gone at 22:00 JST; better pieces equipped automatically)
climb.end.retreat: You retreated. This yokai scores 0; next time it is back at full HP.
climb.end.rest: No swing for over a minute, so this counts as a rest. This yokai scores 0 and returns at full HP.
climb.end.ko: Your HP reached 0, so this counts as a rest. This yokai scores 0 and returns at full HP.
climb.end.newday: It passed 22:00 JST, so a new mountain has begun.
